answers.core: This is basic functionality for the RichTextLabel.
answers.workaround: This can be [worked around](https://godotengine.org/qa/27229/how-to-vertically-align-text-in-a-richtextlabel?show=92485#a92485) by adding a container around the RichTextLabel, but this is less convenient than having it built-in like with a regular Label.
